sources.title: Using Codex with your ChatGPT plan
sources.relevance: Confirms Codex plan usage, plugin controls, model/version variability, and data-control surfaces.

sources.title: OpenAI Docs MCP
sources.relevance: Confirms OpenAI's docs MCP is read-only documentation access and can be configured through Codex.

sources.title: Model Context Protocol architecture overview
sources.relevance: Defines MCP host/client/server separation, JSON-RPC data layer, and stdio versus streamable HTTP transports.

sources.title: Official MCP Registry
sources.relevance: Confirms a public registry surface exists for MCP server discovery, requiring separate trust and quality gates before activation.

decisions: Use MCP sources as context and capability discovery, not as authority to mutate provider accounts.
Keep OpenAI docs MCP as a candidate read-only documentation lane before any OpenAI product/API implementation changes.
Classify remote MCP servers and registry entries as untrusted third-party surfaces until inspected and pinned.
Preserve v101 provider probing as local command availability/version checks with no secret reads and no provider writes.
